text:
amar: noticed elevated prefill latencies after yesterday's token prototype flip. Some prefixes show extra read-before-write on renew path.

miranda: can you share three example traces?

amar: pasted anon trace IDs in the log. pattern: renew -> write token -> read meta -> client blocks on read -> sweeper later reads token again. overall tail increased by ~8ms p95.

samir: expected: additional small-key write on renew will add latency. question: do we need strong write ack for token or can we afford fire-and-forget with best-effort?

olivia: if we make token write async, sweeper could run before token persisted and evict. that reintroduces race. but maybe we can write token to a local durable ring buffer + flush background to reduce tail for RPC callers.

kevin: other option: piggyback token on existing heartbeat writes (single RPC) instead of separate op. are we doing separate writes today?

amar: current proto did separate small write to a token namespace. piggybacking seems better but compactor/namespace semantics differ; we'd need to ensure compactor preserves token keys or we change storage layout.

drew: ops-bot: alert: token_write_latency_p95 increased (labels: cluster=staging, env=canary) :warning:

miranda: short-term: make renew write piggyback to meta blob to reduce two-RPC cost, and keep token as separate fallback if piggyback fails due to size. medium-term: evaluate batching token writes for hot tenants.

samir: piggyback tradeoffs: meta blob writes may be heavier and hit compactor path. but if we keep token as small field in meta, compactor flip (from earlier) will preserve it. good compromise.

olivia: implement piggyback path in renew client SDK. if meta_write fails, fallback to separate token write with retry budget. also expose metric: token_write_mode=piggyback vs token_write_mode=separate.

kevin: owners + timeline:
- amar: validate p95 impact with traces (today)
- olivia: implement piggyback fallback (2d)
- samir: run load tests for QPS budget (3d)
- drew: dashboard token_write_mode breakdown (today)

miranda: also add SLO note: any change must not increase p99 by >15ms. callout to SRE if regressions.

ops-bot: info: token write retry budget exhausted 3 times in last hour (cluster=staging)

drew: will add alert on retry budget exhaustion.

amar: thanks. will follow up with trace samples.
